profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Computer Science Engineer with a passion for programming and software development. As a Full Stack Developer, I have hands-on experience with technologies like React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, and Nest.js. I excel in collaborative and agile environments, consistently delivering efficient and scalable solutions. Throughout my career, I have worked closely with development teams and product managers to design and implement innovative software solutions. My dedication to writing clean code, meeting deadlines, and continuous learning has been pivotal in my professional development.

positions.title: Backend Software Developer
positions.locationName: Santa Ana, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, and maintained backend applications using Node.js with NestJS,
ensuring high performance and scalability.
• Contributed to a microservice architecture for three key staffing-related applications:
       1. HR Management System: A comprehensive platform for managing HR processes across
            various companies
       2. Staffing Agency Connector: A platform enabling seamless collaboration between job
            seekers, staff agencies, and hiring agencies
       3. Integration API: A central service facilitating communication between applications within
            the ecosystem
• Managed databases with MongoDB, integrating advanced features like data aggregation pipelines and indexing for optimization.
• Implemented authentication and authorization systems using Amazon Cognito, enhancing
security and user management.
• Handled environment variables securely using Amazon Secret Manager, ensuring compliance
with industry standards.
• Built and deployed containerized applications using Docker, streamlining development and
deployment pipelines.
• Developed end-to-end features, ensuring quality through rigorous testing and code reviews.
• Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust solutions aligned with business
objectives.
positions.insights: Skills: NestJS · Nodejs · Database Design · TypeScript · MongoDB · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Backend · JavaScript · Amazon Cognito

positions.description: Skills: Firebase · Unit Testing · Skill Development · PostgreSQL · Git · Communication · Express.js · Server Side · React.js · Nodejs · Web Content · Database Design · MongoDB · Full Stack Development · Next.js · MySQL · TypeScript · JavaScript · Creative Problem Solving

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Implemented features using Node.js with the Nest.js framework in an application that generated and managed Ads in a parking mobile application.
• Designed and implemented, together with my team a web application from scratch for a call center aimed at customer service using the Athena Bitcoin wallet in El Salvador, using technologies like React.js, Next.js, and Redux.
• Developed features on the API for the Athenas Bitcoin call center using Python with Django Rest Framework.
• Developed and tested features on the Athenas Bitcoin wallet API in El Salvador using Django Rest Framework.
• Designed and implemented stress tests for the Athenas Bitcoin wallet API using JavaScript and K6 tools.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented a web application using React and Firebase called SAmeals. This web app aimed to show the nearest restaurants to the user depending on the chosen type of food.
• Developed e-commerce and inventory management application using React and Node.js with Express.
• Created unit tests for full stack web application components.
• Researched and implemented new technologies to improve development processes.
